_comment: Extra prompt text for a phase-f4 CHANGE or FIX (npdev_relay_prompts.py appends it after the intent block; npdev_relay_engine.py decides which one). It lives in its OWN file on purpose: relay-prompts.json is bench-measured and the bench records its sha256, so a prompt that is not an f4 conversation stays byte-identical to what was measured. THIS TEXT IS NOT MEASURED YET -- run the relay bench arm on a split app and on a model above the answer budget before the Manager ever passes phase f4. string.Template syntax: $name substitutes, a literal dollar is written $$ (so a $$ref below is the JSON key $ref).
files:
This app is made of several files: the model.json above only points at the others. Here is every file you may change, as it is now:

$listing

How to answer for this app: send model.json (exactly as it is if you did not change it) and, each as its own NPDEV-FILE block, the COMPLETE content of every other file you changed or add. A new file goes under fragments/ or contexts/ and also needs its {"$$ref": "fragments/<name>.json"} entry in model.json. A file you do not send stays exactly as it is. In the NPDEV-END line, files= is the number of files you send.$locked
filesLocked: These files are also part of the app but cannot be changed from here, so leave them out: $names.
upsert:
Size: this model is too big to write out again whole in one answer, so for this task do NOT send model.json. Send only the parts you create or change, as npdev-elements.json, in place of model.json:

NPDEV-FILE npdev-elements.json
```json
{
  "upsert": { "concepts": [ (each concept you create or change, COMPLETE with all its fields) ], "flows": [ (...) ] },
  "remove": { "concepts": [ "NameOfAConceptToRemove" ] },
  "renames": [ { "from": "OldName", "to": "NewName" } ]
}
```
NPDev finds each element by its "name" and REPLACES it with yours, so a changed element must be written COMPLETE (a concept keeps every field it had), never only what changed. Everything you do not send stays exactly as it is. Leave out the keys you do not need. "upsert" and "remove" take these lists: $keys. These lists cannot be sent this way: $wholeOnly; if the change needs one of them, say so in "couldNotExpress". Use "remove" only for what I asked to remove. Still send npdev-submission.json as described above, and in the NPDEV-END line files= is the number of files you send.
